Frequently asked questions

Can't find what you're looking for? Chat with our support team — real people, usually within an hour.

Can I import my existing docs?

Yes. Quillstack imports Markdown, HTML, Word files and exports from most popular wikis. Page links, images and nesting are kept, and you can run an import as often as you like during your trial.

Is there a free plan?

Starter is free forever for up to 10 members, with unlimited pages.

How does billing work for guests?

Guests are free. You only pay for members who can create and edit pages in your workspace.

Where is my data stored?

In the EU or US region of your choice, encrypted at rest and in transit.

Can I cancel at any time?

Yes. Cancel from your billing settings and keep access until the end of the period.
